desc: Derive the exact LCS-row transition when appending one lowercase character, and verify that the final row entry equals the LCS length.
Determine a compact enumeration or memoized representation of all reachable DP-row states for a fixed S, including bounds on their number.
Design the transition-count construction that groups the 26 letters producing the same next state, handling repeated characters in S.
Choose and implement an efficient way to process M positions over the state graph, such as repeated vector transitions or matrix exponentiation if needed.
Validate the method on edge cases such as S containing all identical letters, M=1, and states yielding every possible LCS length, then specify the final Python implementation and modulo handling.
